name: GuruPro AI-1 Golden Retrieval Dataset
description: Deterministic baseline dataset for educational source extraction, chunking, retrieval, and grounding validation.

cases.categoryName: Exact factual query
cases.query: Berapa nilai default administrative distance untuk routing statis?

cases.categoryName: Natural-language query
cases.query: Bagaimana cara mencatat jurnal penyesuaian saat perusahaan membayar premi asuransi kebakaran di muka?

cases.categoryName: Paraphrase query with educational synonyms (biaya asuransi dibayar di muka)
cases.query: Bagaimana cara penyesuaian biaya asuransi dibayar di muka sebesar Rp 3.000.000?

cases.categoryName: Paraphrase query with educational synonyms (jarak administratif perutean)
cases.query: Berapa jarak administratif standar perutean statis pada mikrotik?

cases.categoryName: Query using terminology appearing in the source
cases.query: Apa fungsi sensor Mass Air Flow MAF dan Throttle Position Sensor TPS pada mesin EFI?

cases.categoryName: Query using equivalent wording / synonyms
cases.query: Kelebihan dan keunggulan memakai perutean manual dibanding protokol dinamis
cases.expectedSnippetMustContain: beban kerja prosesor router relatif lebih rendah

cases.categoryName: Query targeting a specific section
Query whose answer exists in the source but is far from the beginning
cases.query: Apa arti indikator status flag AS dan U pada tabel routing RouterOS?

cases.categoryName: Query where multiple chunks are relevant
cases.query: Perbedaan konfigurasi port access dan trunk serta pemetaan nomor VLAN ID

cases.categoryName: Query where nearby chunks are irrelevant
cases.query: Berapa interval jarak tempuh penggantian saringan bahan bakar fuel filter?

cases.categoryName: Query asking for information that does NOT exist (negative grounding)
cases.query: Bagaimana aturan pembagian VLAN encapsulation dan subinterface 802.1Q pada topologi ini?

cases.categoryName: Query asking for crypto asset accounting in service company journal
cases.query: Bagaimana jurnal penyesuaian untuk penurunan nilai aset kripto Bitcoin dan Ethereum?

cases.categoryName: Query asking for electric vehicle cooling in gasoline EFI engine
cases.query: Berapa tekanan sirkulasi cairan pendingin pada paket baterai traksi lithium-ion?

cases.categoryName: Negative query asserting diesel common rail in gasoline EFI engine
cases.query: Sistem injeksi bahan bakar EFI bensin menggunakan pompa common rail diesel bertekanan 2000 bar

cases.categoryName: Negative query asserting Cisco Catalyst switch in MikroTik static routing source
cases.query: Konfigurasi routing statis pada switch Cisco Catalyst 2960 menggunakan perintah ip route

cases.categoryName: Negative query asserting 5 VLAN trunking in static routing source
cases.query: Pembagian 5 VLAN trunking pada subinterface routing statis router MikroTik
